column5: This workbook must be open in a separate Excel instance, with VBA-CSV.xlsm open in the other instance
Position the recording area over cells A1 -> M14 of sheet GIF in workbook VBA-CSV.xlsm, adjust the top of the recording area to also show the formula bar.
Hit the recod button at the bottom right of the recording area overlay thingy
Run the method MakeGIF over here in this Excel instance, by clicking Button 1
That sends recorded keystrokes - more consistently than I'm ever able to type!
Don't forget to clcik the stop recording asap after send keys method MakeGIF exits.
In ScreenToGIF, delete frames before action starts and after action ends
Delete duplicate frames but make timing be "sum"
